newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wah Tak Fung IPO seen 15 times subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: Wah Tak Fung IPO seen 15 times subscribed - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering of shares of Hong Kong-based property group Wah Tak Fung Holdings Ltd is expected to be about 15 times subscribed at the close of the offer on Friday, market sources said.
A formal statement on the subscription results will be made on September 25. Dealing in shares is to begin on September 30.
Crosby Capital Markets (Asia) Ltd and Amsteel Corporate Finance (HK) Ltd are the sponsors of the new issue.
Wah Tak Fung offered 138 million new shares at HK$1.88 per share to raise a net HK$245 million to fund its purchase of land and properties interests. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
